description: Cross-validated from freelancer.com, Upwork, SMB procurement reports, enterprise AI trends
validation: Multiple data sources: freelancer platforms + Upwork skills report + China SMB procurement data + banking AI agent deployments

freelance_demand_across_platforms.key_insight: Applied AI (not building AI) is where the money is. Buyers want plumbing, not intelligence. Connect-this-to-that, replace-the-spreadsheet.

china_smb_procurement_2026.summary: 62.8% have basic digital. Only 21.3% deep AI. 41.5% gap.
what_smbs_reject: 便宜的碎片化工具 (二次改造成本更高)
china_smb_procurement_2026.price_sensitivity: 58.5% abandoned AI tools due to cost. Net margin avg 4.4%
china_smb_procurement_2026.banking_ai_agent_explosion: 苏州银行 6 AI agent projects. 宁波银行 9. 常熟银行 46 agents deployed. Efficiency +20%.

upwork_key_shift.core_finding: AI isn't replacing humans — it's redistributing work. 77% of business leaders say AI increases their need for freelance talent.
upwork_key_shift.meta_skill_2: Workflow design with state/retries/audit trails (outlasts individual tools)
upwork_key_shift.automation_buyer_reality: 1,000+ jobs analyzed. Buyers want tools, not digital coworkers. 'Plumbing, not intelligence.'
